https://github.com/alphacep/vosk-api

Java Native Access 5.18.1 (net.java.dev.jna:jna)
Doppel uses the Apache-2.0 option of JNA's dual license.
See JNA-LICENSE.txt and Apache-2.0.txt.
https://github.com/java-native-access/jna/tree/5.18.1
JNA's native library includes libffi; see libffi-LICENSE.txt.

Vosk's published Android native build uses these additional projects:
- Kaldi (vosk-android branch): Apache-2.0, Apache-2.0.txt.
  https://github.com/alphacep/kaldi/tree/vosk-android
- OpenFst: Apache-2.0, Apache-2.0.txt.
  https://github.com/alphacep/openfst
- OpenBLAS 0.3.20: BSD-3-Clause, OpenBLAS-LICENSE.txt.
  https://github.com/OpenMathLib/OpenBLAS/tree/v0.3.20
- CLAPACK 3.2.1: BSD-3-Clause, CLAPACK-COPYING.txt.
  https://github.com/alphacep/clapack/tree/v3.2.1
- libf2c: permissive AT&T/Lucent/Bellcore notice, F2C-NOTICE.txt.
- Android NDK C++ runtime: libcxx-LICENSE.txt, libcxxabi-LICENSE.txt,
  libunwind-LICENSE.txt, including Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception and
  the reproduced legacy notices. Texts are from LLVM 18.1.8.
  https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/tree/llvmorg-18.1.8

The upstream AAR contains native binaries but no complete build provenance or
transitive NOTICE inventory. The list above follows its published build script;
it does not identify the exact source revision of every prebuilt object.
Preserve these texts with binary redistributions.

Optional Chinese speech model: vosk-model-small-cn-0.22.
Published by Alpha Cephei under Apache-2.0 in the official model listing:
https://alphacephei.com/vosk/models
https://alphacephei.com/vosk/models/vosk-model-small-cn-0.22.zip
Verified archive SHA-256:
3af8b0e7e0f835ae9d414ce5df580237a3cfb08d586c9fbbb0f7ff29ad5b14ba
The archive is downloaded separately and is not bundled in Doppel source or APKs.
See Apache-2.0.txt for its license. Provider-hosted model updates require a new
integrity and license check.

Android Hidden Api Bypass 6.1 (org.lsposed.hiddenapibypass:hiddenapibypass)
Published by LSPosed.
Apache License 2.0; see Apache-2.0.txt.
https://github.com/LSPosed/AndroidHiddenApiBypass
Used for targeted access to this process's own overlay SurfaceControls so that
one full-display capture can exclude Doppel overlays without hiding them.

open-webSearch (source adaptation; no Node.js runtime bundled)
Copyright 2025 Open-WebSearch MCP Server Contributors.
Apache License 2.0; see Apache-2.0.txt.
https://github.com/Aas-ee/open-webSearch/tree/400678eac49521de8c3bb139f263c83d7300416e
OpenWebSearchParsing.kt adapts src/engines/bing/parser.ts and the result parsing
functions in src/engines/sogou/sogou.ts to Kotlin and jsoup.
Doppel modifications: reuse the existing bounded HTTPS transport, enforce public
HTTPS destinations, bound redirect decoding and output, omit browser/server
runtimes and keyword challenge classification. See docs/developer/web-research.md.

Agent Reach website channel (Kotlin source adaptation)
Copyright (c) 2025 Agent Eyes.
MIT; complete upstream license reproduced in agent-reach/LICENSE.
https://github.com/Panniantong/Agent-Reach/tree/a19a171fa980a0785849596492e0af4db800c82f
JinaReaderChannel.kt retains the bounded UTF-8 Markdown envelope adaptation
originally derived from agent_reach/channels/web.py WebChannel.read.
Doppel now fetches and extracts websites locally using the Jina Reader core
and Android WebView; it no longer calls the hosted r.jina.ai website service.
The upstream keyword challenge classifier, social/video tools, Python runtime,
browser-cookie tools and installers are not included.
The existing open-webSearch search-engine adaptation remains separate.
See agent-reach/SOURCE.md and docs/developer/web-research.md.

PdfBox-Android 2.0.27.0 (com.tom-roush:pdfbox-android)
Android port by Tom Roush / PdfBox-Android Developers.
Apache License 2.0; see Apache-2.0.txt.
https://github.com/TomRoush/PdfBox-Android
https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/com/tom-roush/pdfbox-android/2.0.27.0/
Used unchanged for on-device PDF text extraction. No PDF contents are sent to a
separate document conversion service.

The port includes Apache PDFBox and FontBox code and bundled font/glyph data.
Their complete LICENSE and NOTICE texts are reproduced, without edits, from the
published Apache PDFBox / FontBox 2.0.27 jars in PDFBOX-LICENSE.txt,
PDFBOX-NOTICE.txt, FONTBOX-LICENSE.txt, and FONTBOX-NOTICE.txt. These include the
Adobe glyph/CMap, Unicode, Liberation font (SIL OFL), and TwelveMonkeys notices.
Resource-specific notices also remain in the bundled AAR resource files.
https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/org/apache/pdfbox/pdfbox/2.0.27/
https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/org/apache/pdfbox/fontbox/2.0.27/

assistant-ui MessageRepository (Kotlin source adaptation)
Copyright (c) 2025 AgentbaseAI Inc.
MIT; complete upstream license reproduced in assistant-ui-LICENSE.txt.
https://github.com/assistant-ui/assistant-ui/tree/5f21b37bee60458cf721b68369b251636cd939e3
ConversationMessageRepository.kt adapts the parent/children/remembered-next/head
algorithms, branch switching and parent-first export from
packages/core/src/runtime/utils/message-repository.ts. Behavioral fixtures in
ConversationMessageRepositoryTest.kt adapt the sibling, nested branch,
export/import and long-history cases from packages/core/src/tests/MessageRepository.test.ts.
Doppel modifications: Kotlin and copied JSON payloads; each payload represents a
chat turn or immutable task reference. Reparenting, deletion, optimistic nodes,
React conversion and destructive resetHead are omitted. Persistence imports
require a leaf head, retaining all saved sibling branches. The Gateway transaction
and task-queue integration are Doppel-specific, not supplied by assistant-ui.

Apache POI 5.5.1 and centic9/poi-on-android
Used for local DOC/DOCX/PPT/PPTX/XLS/XLSX text extraction.
Pinned Android adapter commit a29c7a4cdd94175c2be43678c82afc818b60ff3f.
Copyright 2015-2024 Dominik Stadler; Apache License 2.0.
See poi-android/NOTICE.txt and the original, per-dependency LICENSE/NOTICE files
in poi-android/. Rebuild instructions and artifact hashes accompany the library.
https://github.com/centic9/poi-on-android
https://poi.apache.org/

DeepSeek Harness file-reference guidance (Chinese adaptation)
Copyright (c) 2026 DeepSeek.
MIT; complete upstream license reproduced in deepseek-harness-LICENSE.txt.
https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/tree/ddefc45fbc7f8e46dd73185e68295696d1297887
ChatAttachmentContext.PROMPT adapts FILE_REFERENCE_PROMPT from
packages/context/file-reference/src/index.ts: references do not imply their
contents have been read; inspect through the file tool before claiming to have
read them. Doppel uses conversation-owned attachment IDs rather than workspace
paths, translates the guidance into Chinese, and retains its existing bounded
character paging, context budget and untrusted-content rules. The Harness
Node/Python runtime, filesystem editor and Office preview engine are not bundled
into the Android app by this adaptation.

Jina Reader Markify core (embedded browser bundle)
Copyright 2020-2024 Jina AI Limited. Apache License 2.0.
Unmodified src/services/markify.ts from revision
1574bfd380d249c86c82db4dace0d9c8fe17e2b1 is compiled for the page DOM.
https://github.com/jina-ai/reader/tree/1574bfd380d249c86c82db4dace0d9c8fe17e2b1
See jina-reader/JINA-LICENSE.txt and jina-reader/SOURCE.md.
Doppel's adapter removes active and form/editor content from a detached DOM,
uses Mozilla Readability for article selection, and bounds Markdown output.
It does not include the Jina server, Puppeteer, cloud integrations or licensed
server assets. Rebuild source and smoke checks: tools/jina-reader-core/.
